text: Waking up before the parents on a Saturday, creeping down the hall toward the living room in pajamas
Sitting cross-legged way too close to a boxy CRT television, cartoons glowing on the screen
A big bowl of brightly colored sugary cereal, milk tinted from the dye, spoon mid-bite
The cereal box propped up on the coffee table, its cartoon mascot facing the TV like a tiny audience member
Turning a channel dial or flipping a paper TV Guide to find the right cartoon block
Two siblings squabbling over the last of the cereal and the best spot on the floor
Eyes glued to a toy commercial flashing across the screen during the break
